dedupe_keys.name: a synthetic vulnerable population dataset for fine scale geographical equity analysis and urban planning

description: A synthetic vulnerable population dataset for fine scale geographical equity analysis and urban planning is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jérémy Gelb et al. Assessing the social and economic vulnerability of populations within a given area supports environmental equity evaluations and the development of effective public policies to mitigate disparities. However, prevailing indicators used to measure socio-economic vulnerability exhibit several shortcomings. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: GeoPackage, Parquet. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
